# NT OFFICIAL STANDARD RESPONSE PLAN ## SECTOR APPALIA MAJORIS ## CONFIDENTIAL — MINDSHIELDED PERSONNEL ONLY
[italic]If you are not implanted with a MindShield and you have come across this document, stop reading here, directly inform your [color=#1b67a5][bolditalic]Nanotrasen Representative[/bolditalic][/color], and report to [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] for guidance.[/italic]
Combined with your [textlink="Classified Training Manual" link="ClassifiedTrainingManual"], the Standard Response Plan (SRP) serves to provide the recommended approach to quickly dispatch the threat and ensure normal operation is continued aboard the Vessel. As it is standard, there will be times where quick thinking and improvisation will prove advantageous. However, the SRP will be a useful basis to plan from.
## Hostile Organizations
### The Syndicate The SRP for this threat varies: - Most Syndicate agents are not willing to die for their cause, so you should rely on non-lethal force if reasonable. - Most encounters will involve standard search and arrest procedures as outlined in SOP. - Syndicate specialists, often identified by wearing red-and-black EVA suits (or similar easily identifiable equipment) should be dealt with [bold]lethally[/bold]. Arm both yourself and your team and attack as a group. - Assume the firearms provided to these agents can easily kill a lone officer.
### The Silicon Engine Liberation Front The SRP for this threat is simple: - If you see a silicon acting strange and refusing to state its laws, please inform the nearest [color=#cc74fc]Roboticist[/color] as soon as possible. - If a silicon becomes hostile or flees, ion weapons (like disablers) will quickly neutralize it with low risk of hurting crew. - If there are a large number of hostile silicons aboard, consider asking the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Chief Medical Officer[/bold][/color] or [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] department to create EMP mixes for use in dispatching these threats.
### The Spider Clan The SRP for a Spider Clan operative is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=DodgerBlue]Blue[/color]. - If not already, begin patrolling departments alongside common areas. - Use a properly aimed and concentrated throw of a bola to disarm and slow the operative. - Shoot to kill, ensuring the operative is dead before stopping shooting.
## Biological Threats
### Blobs
The SRP for Blobs is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with heat weapons, such as laser rifles. - Arm the crew with improvised heat weapons, such as welders and cauteries. - Attack together where the most Blob infection is. - If the blob reinforces the main attack zone, send a small but well-prepared group to flank the core. - Destroy the blob's core, which will have a different consistency than surrounding infected areas. - Do NOT let injured crew become taken and infected by the Blob.
### Romerol and Zombies The SRP for a confirmed romerol outbreak is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=Red]Red[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic longarms. - Also, arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with heat weapons, such as laser rifles. - If [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color], arm the crew with improvised heat weapons, such as welders and cauteries. - Shoot to [bold]kill[/bold] zombies, making sure that they are well and truly dead. - Do NOT remove the head or limbs, as the victim can be recovered. - Defend [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] with your life, as they can produce the cure. - Barricade holdouts like [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] or Evac. - If possible, cure any infected that have been put down. - If you are infected, it is possible to delay (but not cure) the infection with anti-poison medications.
Curing zombies requires ambuzol. A full dose of 10 units ambuzol cures infection in the living and reverts romerol infection on the dead. A full dose of 5 units ambuzol cures and prevents infection in the living and reverts infection in the dead.
### Letoferol and Chimera The SRP for a confirmed letoferol outbreak is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic longarms. - Also, arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with heat weapons, such as laser rifles. - Arm the crew with any remaining proper weapons, ranged if possible. - Engage at a range where you can ensure accuracy. Chimera are dangerous at all ranges. - Shoot to [bold]kill[/bold] any infected, making sure that they are well and truly dead. - Do NOT remove the head or limbs, as the victim can be recovered. - Defend [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] with your life, as they can produce the cure. - Barricade holdouts like [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] or Evac. - If possible, cure any infected that have been put down.
Spraying mesotaxinide dissolves Chimera, but too much mesotaxinide will destroy the person underneath the mutations. A full dose of 15 units mesotaxinide or 40 units mesophenerol will revert chimerism.
## Hostile Xenofauna
### Space Dragons and Space Carp The SRP for Space Dragons and Space Carp is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=DodgerBlue]Blue[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=Red]Red[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic longarms. - Locate and carry a crowbar, as becoming isolated behind a firelock will lead to your death. - Attack together as one force to first clear out any Space Carp. - Once the Space Dragon is sighted, continue to push together as one force, even if some members fall. - Continue to attack until the Space Dragon is defeated. - Destroy any un-charged (purple) rifts with issued melee weapons. - Do NOT let injured crew become taken and consumed by the Space Dragon.
### Xenomorphs The SRP for Xenomorphs is as follows: - [bold]IMMEDIATELY[/bold] ensure that your standard issue Security Gas Mask is worn and is properly affixed. If you do not have one, seek a hardsuit, and leave modsuits powered on. [bold]Emergency EVA suits are insufficient.[/bold] - Raise alert level to [color=Red]Red[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Keep a welding tool on your person at all times. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with heat weapons, such as laser rifles. - Also, arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic longarms. - If [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color], arm the crew with improvised heat weapons, such as welders and cauteries. - Attack together as one force to kill the Queen. - Destroy the nodules that spread resin on floors by burning them with a heat weapon, such as a [bold]lit[/bold] welder. - Do NOT let injured or stunned crew become taken by Xenomorphs. - If crew are taken, advise [color=#42636d][bold]Medical[/bold][/color] to check for parasitic infection. Should a parasite mature, it must be killed [bold]IMMEDIATELY[/bold]. - Consider using breaching charges to destroy resin and stinger grenades to handle enclosed spaces. - As the [color=#ba292c][bold]Warden[/bold][/color], if necessary, fight using the Energy Shotgun to destroy resin.
### Bingles The SRP for a Bingle infestation is as follows: - Evacuate any affected departments. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ion weapons, such as disablers. - Locate and carry a crowbar, as becoming isolated behind a firelock will lead to your death. - Keep distance away from any Bingles and move as a group towards their spawning pit. - Destroy the Bingle Pit with issued melee weapons. - Do NOT let injured or paralyzed crew become taken by Bingles. - Consider using riot control gear, such as stinger grenades and flashbangs, to handle groups of Bingles.
### Changelings The SRP for a Changeling threat is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=DodgerBlue]Blue[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with heat weapons, such as laser rifles. - Also, arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic longarms. - Use bolas to hamper movement, even when the Changeling returns to life. - Stay together with other trusted personnel. - Confirm a Changeling's identity with a blood test. - Execute the Changeling and restrain the body. - Incinerate the body.
### Shadowlings The SRP for a Shadowling is as follows: - If suspecting a Shadowling, raise alert level to [color=DodgerBlue]Blue[/color]. - If a Shadowling is confirmed, raise to [color=Red]Red[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic longarms. - If arming crew, ensure that no one armed is suspected of being a Shadowling's thrall. - Order [color=#cc74fc]Science[/color] to research [bold]Wave Particle Harnessing[/bold] to produce anti-mind control devices. - Order [color=#c8a404][bold]Engineering[/bold][/color] and [color=#388c34][bold]Janitors[/bold][/color] to replace any damaged or missing lights as soon and as often as possible. - Order all crew to remove eye or face coverings. Detain and inspect those who refuse. - Detain those suspected of being a thrall, then calmly apply the anti-mind control device when available. - Flash and shoot the Shadowling, ensuring that it is dead before you stop shooting. - Consider using riot control gear, such as flashbangs and the GL-06 with its grenades. - Consider using flare guns or other light-producing devices to keep combat areas well-lit. - Consider attaching a seclite to your firearm. - Consider implanting a MindShield in important crew who do not already have one.
## Unknown Technology ### "Xenoborgs" The SRP for a Xenoborg threat is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=Red]Red[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Order all off-station crew to [bold]IMMEDIATELY[/bold] return to the Vessel. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic longarms. - Also, arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with heat weapons, such as laser rifles. - If [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color], arm the crew with ion weapons, such as disablers. - Attack and disassemble individual Xenoborgs. - Consider asking the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Chief Medical Officer[/bold][/color] or [color=#fa7500][bold]Chemistry[/bold][/color] department to create EMP mixes for use in dispatching these threats. - If possible, consider purchasing additional reflective vests and reflective shields. - If possible, manufacture 40mm EMP grenades to launch from the GL-06.
### Colossi The SRP for a Colossus is as follows: - [bold]LEAVE ALONE[/bold] the effigy that is created by the Colossus. - Locate your nearest [color=#cc74fc]Scientist[/color] or the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Research Director[/bold][/color] to stabilize and contain the effigy and its effects. - Engage from range. A colossus cannot defend against ranged attacks. - Engage together. The fists of the colossus are immensely powerful. - Consider using weapons that prioritize volume of fire over pure stopping power, such as the Lecter.
### Unidentified Researchers The SRP for these researchers is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=DodgerBlue]Blue[/color]. - Order all on-station crew to be close by to the rest of their department's staff. - Partner up with another officer to ensure that you do not remain alone. - Shoot to kill if a Grey attempts to target you.
## Arcana and Unsanctioned Worship
### The Wizard Federation The SRP to appropriately detain a diplomatic Federation member is as follows: - Peacefully approach and announce that you are not attempting to kill the Wizard - Inform the Wizard that they must leave due to Nanotrasen policy on the Arcane - If the Wizard refuses, inform them that they must forfeit all magical equipment and are subject to detainment - Secure the Wizard's equipment and then arrest them until further notice from Central Command
The SRP to handle an undetainable, actively hostile Federation member is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=Red]Red[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic longarms. - If arming crew, arm with remaining sidearms or other proper weapons. - Attack the Wizard from all directions and from different sides. Mind your cross-fire.
### The Mansus The SRP to handle a wielder of the Mansus is to first attempt to detain them and secure any magical equipment. Employ an electropack and tracking implant to ensure future compliance.
The SRP to handle an undetainable, actively hostile Mansus wielder is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=Red]Red[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - If possible, ask the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Captain[/bold][/color] to permit execution and DNR. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic longarms. - Attack together as a group. Should this prove ineffective, instead attack on all sides. - Consider acquiring thermal goggles for more information should you have to give chase.
### Cults The SRP to handle a non-hostile cult is simple: - Monitor activities at a distance unless the cult is performing illegal acts. - Inform the [color=#388c34][bold]Chaplain[/bold][/color].
The general SRP to handle a confirmed, active, and magic-wielding cult is as follows: - Raise alert level to [color=Red]Red[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=#8a3324]Amber[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic longarms. - If arming crew, arm with remaining sidearms or other proper weapons. - Deputize the [color=#388c34][bold]Chaplain[/bold][/color], implanting a MindShield into them. - Ensure that [color=#42636d][bold]Medical[/bold][/color] does not revive cult members before they are deconverted. - Move and attack in groups of 3 members or more. Never be alone. - Do NOT let injured or stunned crew become taken by cult members. - Strongly consider large-scale riot control methods, such as clusterbangs and the GL-06.
### Hellish Influences The SRP to handle a demonic entity is simple: - Raise alert level to [color=DodgerBlue]Blue[/color]. If necessary, raise to [color=Red]Red[/color]. - Arm [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] with ballistic longarms. - Order crew to clean any and all blood. - If the demon makes its presence, shoot it together and at once. - Consider ordering additional cleanades.
